graph.name: NovaMart Domain Knowledge Graph
graph.description: Semantic knowledge graph over NovaMart store policies, product category constraints, and SQLite ontology.

nodes.label: Policy Version Cutoff Date (2026-06-01)
nodes.summary: Orders placed before 2026-06-01 follow Policy v1. Orders placed on or after follow Policy v2.

properties.rule: Evaluated strictly by orders.order_date, never current time

nodes.label: Refund Policy v1 (Prior to 2026-06-01)
nodes.summary: Orders < 2026-06-01: Change-of-mind 10 calendar days, Defect 15 calendar days, Restocking fee Rs 0 across all categories, Human approval limit Rs 1,00,000.

nodes.label: Refund Policy v2 (Current, >= 2026-06-01)
nodes.summary: Orders >= 2026-06-01: Change-of-mind 7 calendar days (+2d Gold / +3d Platinum), Defect 10 calendar days, Restocking fee 5% max Rs 2,500 on electronics, Human approval limit Rs 75,000.

nodes.label: 5% Electronics Restocking Fee Rule
nodes.summary: Under Policy v2 change-of-mind returns, high-value electronics incur a 5% restocking fee capped at Rs 2,500. Defective/damaged returns ALWAYS incur Rs 0 fee.

nodes.label: Cancellation Policy (Pre-Shipment)
nodes.summary: Orders can be cancelled before dispatch (status placed, confirmed, processing) for 100% refund including shipping fees. Exempt from human approval thresholds regardless of amount.

nodes.label: Warranty Policy (Brand / Manufacturer)
nodes.summary: Electronics carry 12-24 months manufacturer warranty. After return window closes, customer must be guided to brand authorized service centers with invoice.

nodes.label: Shipping & Delivery Policy
nodes.summary: Free delivery on orders >= Rs 1,000, flat Rs 79 otherwise. Orders >= Rs 5,000 require OTP verification. Goodwill credit Rs 100 per 3 full days late beyond ETA (max Rs 300).

nodes.label: Customer Escalation & Safety Policy
nodes.summary: Mandatory human escalation matrix: Tier 1 Support (standard disputes), Refunds & Payments (>24h pending payment), Logistics Desk (OTP dispute / transit loss), Technical Support (battery swelling / safety), Trust & Safety (serial returns / fraud).

nodes.label: Category: Laptops
nodes.summary: Restocking fee applicable on v2 change-of-mind (5% max Rs 2500). Free replacement on DOA within 10 days.

nodes.label: Category: Tablets
nodes.summary: Restocking fee applicable on v2 change-of-mind (5% max Rs 2500).

nodes.label: Category: Cameras
nodes.summary: Restocking fee applicable on v2 change-of-mind (5% max Rs 2500).

nodes.label: Category: Monitors
nodes.summary: Restocking fee applicable on v2 change-of-mind (5% max Rs 2500). Zero dead-pixel warranty within 10 days.

nodes.label: Category: Smartphones
nodes.summary: No restocking fee. 7d mind / 10d defect return window. Brand warranty 12 months.

nodes.label: Category: Headphones
nodes.summary: Over-ear headphones returnable in intact box. No restocking fee.

nodes.label: Category: Earbuds & In-Ear Audio
nodes.summary: Hygiene non-returnable if inner seal broken or unsealed unless defective on arrival.

nodes.label: Category: Smartwatches
nodes.summary: Standard electronics return window. Must include original magnetic charging cable.

nodes.label: Category: Gaming Consoles & Gear
nodes.summary: Hardware returnable within window. Digital download vouchers non-refundable once scratched.

nodes.label: Category: Keyboards
nodes.summary: Returnable within window. Switches and cables must be included.

nodes.label: Category: Mice & Pointers
nodes.summary: Returnable within window with USB dongle.

nodes.label: Category: Bluetooth Speakers
nodes.summary: Returnable within window. Water damage not covered under defect warranty.

nodes.label: Category: Routers & Networking
nodes.summary: Returnable within window with adapter.

nodes.label: Category: Accessories & Cables
nodes.summary: Unsealed cables and used screen protectors non-returnable.

nodes.label: Hygiene & Intimate Device Return Exclusion
nodes.summary: In-ear earbuds with broken seals, unsealed internal packaging cables, and used screen protectors are strictly non-returnable for hygiene reasons unless confirmed DOA.

nodes.label: Life-Safety Critical Escalation Rule
nodes.summary: Any report of battery swelling, smoking, burning smell, sparks, or severe overheating immediately halts standard flow, provides immediate disconnect advice, and dispatches critical ticket to Technical Support.

nodes.label: OTP-Verified Delivery Contradiction Guardrail
nodes.summary: If orders.delivery_otp_verified == 1 and customer claims package not delivered, automated refund/replacement is strictly BLOCKED. Escalated to Logistics Desk for forensic audit.

nodes.label: Table: customers (1,500 records)
nodes.summary: Stores account profile, shipping address, and loyalty_tier (bronze, silver, gold, platinum).

nodes.label: Table: orders (8,000 records)
nodes.summary: Stores order_date (policy version anchor), order_status, total_amount, courier, tracking, actual_delivery_date, delivery_otp_verified.

nodes.label: Table: order_items (12,444 records)
nodes.summary: Stores line item quantity, unit_price, discount, and final_price (gross refund = round(final_price * 1.18, 2)).

nodes.label: Table: products (300 items)
nodes.summary: Stores catalog items, category, returnable, replacement_available, warranty_months.

nodes.label: Table: support_tickets (2,500+ records)
nodes.summary: Stores ticket_id, category, priority (critical/high/medium/low), escalation_team, status.
